route: Jedinstvena dozvola (single permit for residence and work)

permit.applies: The foreign citizen applies, or the employer (an authorised person) on their behalf, electronically through the Welcome to Serbia portal; a visa-required national first gets a visa D on the basis of employment.
permit.first: An employer in Serbia (the single permit on the basis of employment); a visa D for nationals who need a visa.

fees.what: Visa D (where required), in dinars at the NBS middle rate

sources.title: Welcome to Serbia (Government of Serbia), Information about the Single Permit
sources.said: If a foreign citizen needs a visa to enter Serbia, then they need to apply for a Visa D on the basis of employment. If a foreign citizen is able to come to Serbia without a visa, then upon arrival in Serbia, they have the opportunity to apply for a single work and residence permit that is issued for a period of 36 months. … By submitting a request for the issuance of a single permit, which is resolved within 15 days from the date of submission of the properly completed request … the request for the issuance of a single residence and work permit can be submitted by the foreign citizen as well as by the employer on behalf of the foreign citizen

sources.title: Welcome to Serbia, Help (frequently asked questions)
sources.said: The fee for visa D is 50 euros (payment will be made in the local currency of the Republic of Serbia - dinar (RSD) at the middle exchange rate of the National Bank of Serbia). … Temporary residence can be granted for up to three years and can be extended for the same period, depending on the basis of stay. 12. How much is the temporary residence or single permit application fee? Submission fee 430.00 RSD. Fee for approval of the single permit 22,770.00 RSD.

sources.title: Paragraf Lex, Zakon o zapošljavanju stranaca (consolidated text), čl. 3; rests on the Zakon o zapošljavanju stranaca, Službeni glasnik RS
sources.said: Stranac čiji boravak u Republici ne traje duže od 90 dana u periodu od 180 dana računajući od dana prvog ulaska, odnosno duže od propisanog perioda boravka u skladu međunarodnim ugovorom, ostvaruje pravo na rad u Republici u navedenom periodu bez izdate jedinstvene dozvole, i to stranac koji: … 4) obavlja privremene obrazovne, sportske, umetničke, kulturne i druge slične aktivnosti
